title: blob-types: capability, DigestAlgorithm, BlobRef, DataSourceObject, Blob/set and Blob/get types
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B2. Crates: jmap-blob-types. Size: M.

Implement docs/design/blobext.md §4 (first half) in crate-jmap-blob-types: capability.rs (JMAP_BLOB2_URI, JMAP_BLOB_URI, BlobCapability, BlobAccountCapability with all 17 keys always serialized incl. nulls, check() for maxDataSources>=64 and lowercase digest names, rfc9404() -> Rfc9404AccountCapability with the four RFC 9404 §3.1 fields and `adler` dropped, decision 11), digest.rs (DigestAlgorithm with manual Eq/Ord/Hash on the wire string, property_name/from_property_name, Digest trait, builtin digesters sha/sha-256/sha-512 producing padded RFC 4648 §4 base64), blob_ref.rs (BlobRef Id | #creation), source.rs (DataSourceObject custom serde: digest:* keys to `digests`), set.rs (BlobCreateObject, BlobObject with tri-state expires, BlobUpdated, BlobSetArgs, BlobSetResponse with nullable oldState/newState), get.rs (BlobGetArgs, BlobProperty incl. Id, DataSourceProperty, BlobGetItem, BlobGetResponse, ImageData, ImageGps), errors consts. Specs: blobext-03 §2.1, §3, §4, §5, §7, §11.4; RFC 9530 §7.2; RFC 9404 §3.1. Acceptance (blobext.md §10 'types'): -03 §2.1.1 and §9.1/§9.2 round-trips from hand-written JSON; absent/null oldState/newState/expires parse; DSO serde cases; BlobRef cases; DigestAlgorithm map order and Other("sha")==Sha; digest vectors from RFC 9404 §4.2.1 and RFC 9530 App. B; RFC 9404 §3.1.1 capability round-trip; check() rejects 63; public-api snapshot.
